channel.title: GPT-6.1 Terra — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases: 26 October–1 November 2026
item.description: Terra and Particle expand API choices; Mistral, Liquid and specialist open-weight releases broaden local deployment. Licensing, serving plans and access conditions determine the usable offer.

item.title: Particle-1: token savings and the serving plan behind the bill
item.description: Particle’s coding model has distinct direct peak, off-peak and Flex rates. Vendor task-cost comparisons assume high cache reuse; steering can leave more than one generation billable.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Terra: token prices, long prompts and the routed Pro variant
item.description: OpenAI’s new model costs $1 input/$5 output per million tokens at Standard rates up to 272,000 prompt tokens. Longer prompts and cache retention change the bill; OpenRouter’s Pro route uses the same underlying model.
